operator_scope: Create local main and Shorts previews only; no upload, scheduling or publication approval.

evidence.model: Publisher grants Apache-2.0 for the released weights, ONNX exports, configs and bundled preset voice assets.
evidence.output: Publisher explicitly permits audio from bundled preset voices in commercial and monetized voiceovers, videos, products and services without an additional license or fee.
evidence.speaker_consent: Publisher explicitly confirms the speakers or rightsholders of the bundled presets granted rights and consent for AI training and synthetic speech, including commercial generation.
evidence.ancestry: Publisher states v3 Turbo was designed and trained from scratch, not fine-tuned or distilled from another TTS model. It does not use the previous Piper/Lessac voice.
evidence.disclosure: The internal training corpus is not publicly audited here. Clearance relies on the explicit published model, preset, output and consent grants rather than guessing rights from a dataset tag.

components.name: VieNeu-TTS SDK and bundled Ngọc Huyền preset

constraints: Use the bundled preset only; no external reference audio or cloning in this run.

Commercial voice permission is separate from the owner approving a whole video for publication.
supersedes: Previous Piper/VAIS1000/Lessac voice and CC BY statements are historical, not the voice used by new active audio. Evaluate current manifest references and the resolved command model; old assets are retained for audit.

Preserve current dataset/source rights history without attributing it to this replacement voice.
